citations.claim: First violation: level 40.5857 exceeds capacity 40 at step 15
Valve already fully open at violating step, so controller cannot drain more
No spill recorded despite exceeding capacity
One step before, level 38.58 already near capacity with valve fully open
Valve saturated one step before violation
Tank starts half full at 20, so rise is due to net inflow

counterfactual.change: Lowered mean inflow from 8 to 2 (one field) so net inflow is below max drain of demand 1 + valve max 6 = 7; same 20 steps passes with no violation

explanation: Mean inflow 8 exceeds max drain (demand 1 + valve max 6 = 7), so even with valve saturated at 1 (steps 14-15) level inevitably climbs from 20 to capacity. The declared spill/clamp logic fails: at step 15 level 40.5857 exceeds capacity 40 yet spilled stays 0 instead of clamping to 40 and accumulating excess. Counterfactual with inflow 2 stays controllable and never violates.

violation.detail: The water level never exceeds the tank capacity.
